decisions.why: Theatre caps and headwear products (Basics Theatre Cap, Basics Operating Cap) are general theatre consumables (theatres:theatre).
Procedure masks including Anti-fog Procedure Mask and Procedure Mask with Visor are theatre consumables (theatres:theatre).
Elemental and Plush Surgical Gowns (Standard and Poly-reinforced) are disposable theatre consumables (theatres:theatre).
IV cannulation pack (IVSAFE), catheter insertion pack (ISOCATH), and wound care packs are procedure and cannulation packs (skin-prep:pack).
Theatre shoe covers (Impervious, Heavy Duty, Basics) are general theatre consumables (theatres:theatre).
Short-sleeve and standard Warming Jackets are patient warming consumables (theatres:warm).
Non-sterile patient examination gowns and SMS medical gowns are general theatre consumables (theatres:theatre).
